description: Tail shaft reads as a thin pale line at game size: the sheet's shaft is a furred whip, dark gray on top with the white underside below, visibly thicker than the bare tail; the build's shaft fur is short and sparse, so the white underside dominates and the shaft looks bare. Orchestrator recommended a shaggier shaft on 2026-10-21; Nick did not decline; applied as an overridable decision
camera: side sprite 1x and 2x, idle and signature
region: tail shaft from the tail root to the base of the plume
